chunks.head: lie awake
chunks.note: lie(躺)+awake(醒着的),指躺在床上却睡不着。
chunks.ex_en: She lay awake for hours, worrying about the exam.
chunks.ex_cn: 她躺着睡不着,担心了好几个小时的考试。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 旧式表达,相当于 soon / before long。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“通过”,是旧用法,表时间推移

chunks.ex_en: By and by the rain stopped and the sun came out.
chunks.ex_cn: 过了一会儿,雨停了,太阳出来了。

chunks.head: one's days are numbered
chunks.note: 直译“日子被数尽了”,指所剩时日不多。

literal.note_cn: 此处指数得清、所剩无几

chunks.ex_en: The doctor said the old dog's days were numbered.
chunks.ex_cn: 医生说这条老狗已经时日无多了。

chunks.head: in spite of oneself
chunks.note: 在 in spite of(尽管)后加 oneself,表示违背本意、控制不住。

literal.note_cn: in spite of 为固定搭配,意为“尽管”

chunks.ex_en: The joke was silly, but she laughed in spite of herself.
chunks.ex_cn: 那笑话很傻,可她还是忍不住笑了。

chunks.head: wide awake
chunks.note: wide 在此作副词,加强 awake,表示彻底醒着。

literal.note_cn: 此处不是“宽”,而是加强语气“彻底地”

chunks.ex_en: After that cup of coffee I was wide awake all night.
chunks.ex_cn: 喝了那杯咖啡后,我一整夜都清醒得很。

chunks.head: on all fours
chunks.note: fours 指两手两脚共四肢。
chunks.ex_en: The baby crawled across the floor on all fours.
chunks.ex_cn: 婴儿四肢着地爬过了地板。

chunks.head: move off
chunks.note: 指人或车辆开始离开原地。
chunks.ex_en: The bus moved off before he could get on.
chunks.ex_cn: 他还没上车,公交车就开走了。

chunks.head: under one's breath
chunks.note: 直译“在呼吸之下”,即压低嗓音、几乎听不见。
chunks.ex_en: He muttered a complaint under his breath so no one would hear.
chunks.ex_cn: 他压低嗓子嘟囔着抱怨,免得被人听见。

chunks.head: keep still
chunks.note: still 在此为形容词,指静止不动。

literal.note_cn: 此处不是“仍然”,而是“不动的”

chunks.ex_en: Keep still while I take the splinter out of your hand.
chunks.ex_cn: 我帮你挑手上的刺时,你别乱动。

chunks.head: get even with
chunks.note: even 意为“扯平”,把账算清、两不相欠。
chunks.ex_en: He swore he would get even with the boy who tricked him.
chunks.ex_cn: 他发誓要跟那个骗他的男孩算账。

chunks.head: drive away
chunks.note: drive 在此为“驱赶”,非“驾驶”。
chunks.ex_en: The farmer drove away the birds that were eating his seeds.
chunks.ex_cn: 农夫赶走了那些偷吃种子的鸟。

chunks.head: strike out
chunks.note: 指突然挥出拳头或手臂打击。
chunks.ex_en: The boxer struck out suddenly and knocked his rival down.
chunks.ex_cn: 拳击手突然挥拳出击,把对手打倒在地。

chunks.head: grapple with
chunks.gloss: 与……扭打;搏斗;(引申)努力应对
chunks.note: 字面指抱住扭打,也常引申为“艰难处理(难题)”。
chunks.ex_en: The police grappled with the thief until help arrived.
chunks.ex_cn: 警察和小偷扭打在一起,直到支援赶到。

chunks.head: with might and main
chunks.note: might 与 main(古义“力气”)同义连用,加强“全力”。

literal.note_cn: 古义“力气”,与 might 同义

chunks.ex_en: The sailors pulled the rope with might and main.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们使出浑身力气拉着绳子。

chunks.head: spring to one's feet
chunks.note: spring 在此指“猛地弹起”,形容动作迅疾。
chunks.ex_en: He sprang to his feet the moment he heard the alarm.
chunks.ex_cn: 一听到警报,他猛地站了起来。

chunks.head: all at once
chunks.note: 固定短语,相当于 suddenly。
chunks.ex_en: All at once the lights went out and the room fell dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 突然灯全灭了,房间陷入黑暗。

chunks.head: settle a score
chunks.note: score 在此指“旧账、宿怨”,settle 为“结清”。
chunks.ex_en: He came back to town to settle an old score with his rival.
chunks.ex_cn: 他回到镇上,是要跟对头了结一桩旧怨。

chunks.head: that won't wash
chunks.note: 口语用 wash 表“经得起检验”,否定即“说不通”。
chunks.ex_en: You forgot again? That excuse won't wash with me.
chunks.ex_cn: 你又忘了?这个借口在我这儿可行不通。

chunks.head: stand up for
chunks.note: 指公开为某人或某事辩护、撑腰。
chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand up for you when others blame you.
chunks.ex_cn: 别人指责你时,真正的朋友会为你撑腰。

chunks.head: go back on
chunks.note: 常接 one's word/promise,表示不守承诺。
chunks.ex_en: He is honest and never goes back on a promise.
chunks.ex_cn: 他很讲信用,从不食言。

chunks.head: fair and square
chunks.note: square 在此意为“正直、公道”,与 fair 叠用加强。
chunks.ex_en: She won the race fair and square, with no cheating at all.
chunks.ex_cn: 她赢得这场比赛光明正大,没有任何作弊。

chunks.head: be off
chunks.note: 口语,常表“该走了、赶紧走”。
chunks.ex_en: It's getting late — I must be off now.
chunks.ex_cn: 天不早了,我得走了。

chunks.head: pry off
chunks.note: pry 指用工具撬动。
chunks.ex_en: He pried off the lid of the paint can with a screwdriver.
chunks.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀把油漆桶的盖子撬开了。

skipped: go on digging(go on + -ing 属语法结构,过于基础)
come out(月亮/太阳“出来”,义太基础)
look after(此处为“目送、望着离去”,与常义“照顾”相反,易混,归入难句层)
sent to bed(偏描述性搭配,可迁移性弱)
Injun Joe / Muff Potter / Doctor Robinson(专有名词)
